mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% in the past month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower in tightening periods compared to baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3% in the past three months signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and boosts consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher in tightening labor market periods compared to baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real estate sales by more than 5% in the past two months signals a strengthening housing market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher in periods of increased real estate sales compared to baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production by more than 2% in the past two months signals a weakening supply side, which can lead to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower in periods of decreased industrial production compared to baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment, indicated by CPIAUCSL below 2% for three consecutive months, signals a stable monetary environment, which reduces uncertainty and boosts equity returns, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher in low inflation periods compared to baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls by more than 200,000 in the past month signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher in periods of strong payroll growth compared to baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in real GDP and retail sales by more than 1% each in the past quarter signals a strengthening demand side, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher in periods of joint GDP and retail sales growth compared to baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate coupled with a decrease in consumer price index signals a tightening monetary policy with controlled inflation, which can lead to a stable economic environment and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increase > 0.25% and CPIAUCSL decrease > 0.1% in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher in periods of tightening monetary policy with controlled inflation compared to baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
